A [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual was the '''daughter''' of [[Russell Wake]], the caretaker of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Unidentified factory (Bellassa)|factory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bellassa/Legends|Bellassa]]. Wake also had a [[Russell Wake's wife|wife]].<ref name="Secret weapon" /> Around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]],<ref name="Dates">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The Last of the Jedi: Secret Weapon]]'' to around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]].</ref> after Wake helped members of [[the Eleven]] resistance group enter the [[Factory/Legends|factory]], he was confronted by<ref name="Secret weapon" /> the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]]<ref name="Companion">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], who [[Telekinesis/Legends|choked]] him to [[Death/Legends|death]]. Before he died, Wake thought of the things that nourished him, including his daughter, his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], and his [[Garden/Legends|garden]].<ref name="Secret weapon" />

==Behind the scenes==
Russell Wake's daughter was mentioned in ''[[The Last of the Jedi: Secret Weapon]]'', a [[2007]] junior novel written by [[Jude Watson]] as the seventh installment in the ''[[Star Wars: The Last of the Jedi]]'' series.<ref name="Secret weapon" />
